mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Public Library, but with an air quality index of 54, it is a bit moderate out there.

The City of Verona keeps the infrastructure running smoothly through regular engineering reports from AECOM, while the Senior Center is inviting residents to enjoy nature through their free tri-shaw bike program.
We have plenty of fun ahead with live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmers Market kicks off tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
In a weekly recap, an officer stopped a vehicle on Thursday July 31 for an equipment violation, which led to citations for possession of T H C and drug paraphernalia.
The flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and the shop opens at 10 AM, so stop by later today, or catch the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 4 PM today.
